SELECT n.chain_code AS chain_code, c.chain_name AS chain_name, n.request_url AS request_url, n.request_method AS request_method, n.interface_scope AS interface_scope, n.target_system AS target_system, r.category AS category, n.node_type AS node_type FROM test_node_config n LEFT JOIN test_chain c ON c.chain_code = n.chain_code LEFT JOIN sys_system_registry r ON r.system_code = n.target_system
ORDER BY n.chain_code ASC, n.node_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT n.chain_code, c.chain_name, n.request_url, n.request_method, n.interface_scope, n.target_system, r.category, n.node_type FROM test_node_config n LEFT JOIN test_chain c ON c.chain_code = n.chain_code LEFT JOIN sys_system_registry r ON r.system_code = n.target_system
ORDER BY n.node_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_node_config n LEFT JOIN test_chain c ON c.chain_code = n.chain_code LEFT JOIN sys_system_registry r ON r.system_code = n.target_system

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(n.target_system, n.request_url)) FROM test_node_config n LEFT JOIN test_chain c ON c.chain_code = n.chain_code LEFT JOIN sys_system_registry r ON r.system_code = n.target_system

SELECT COALESCE(n.interface_scope, 'UNKNOWN') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM test_node_config n LEFT JOIN test_chain c ON c.chain_code = n.chain_code LEFT JOIN sys_system_registry r ON r.system_code = n.target_system
GROUP BY COALESCE(n.interface_scope, 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT UPPER(COALESCE(n.request_method, 'GET')) AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM test_node_config n LEFT JOIN test_chain c ON c.chain_code = n.chain_code LEFT JOIN sys_system_registry r ON r.system_code = n.target_system
GROUP BY UPPER(COALESCE(n.request_method, 'GET')) ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COALESCE(c.chain_name, n.chain_code) AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM test_node_config n LEFT JOIN test_chain c ON c.chain_code = n.chain_code LEFT JOIN sys_system_registry r ON r.system_code = n.target_system
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.chain_name, n.chain_code) ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT COALESCE(n.target_system, 'UNKNOWN') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM test_node_config n LEFT JOIN test_chain c ON c.chain_code = n.chain_code LEFT JOIN sys_system_registry r ON r.system_code = n.target_system
GROUP BY COALESCE(n.target_system, 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 50
